items.title: 如何在“不能出错”的系统里使用 AI Coding？分布式存储实践与边界
items.excerpt: 本文结合美团基础技术部在 AI 评审、问题排查和自动化开发中的真实实践，分享 AI 能帮上什么忙、容易在哪些地方犯错，以及哪些地方仍需要人来把关。比「多写代码」更重要的，是让代码和结论经得起验证。

items.title: 美团搜索3.0：LLM 语义表征在排序模型的探索与应用
items.excerpt: 美团搜索团队正依托团垂融合新架构与生成式大模型新技术，全面重构本地生活搜索底座。本系列技术博客将持续介绍美团搜索 3.0 的技术探索，本文聚焦 LLM 语义表征在服务零售排序场景上的三期实践——从单点特征验证到系统性表征体系构建，再到跨场景迁移复用，探索语义匹配信号在搜索排序中的应用路径。

items.title: Agent评测漫谈 —— 由浅入深讲解Agent评测
items.excerpt: 本篇博客是一篇科普文章，由浅入深的介绍Agent评测。其中前两章系统介绍了评测是什么，以及如何建立评测体系；其中第二章是美团图灵Agent评测团队深入美团各业务团队BP总结出的实践经验，是我们在两年实践过程中逐步打磨出来的认知。

items.title: Google to Allow One-Tap Android App Installs From Approved Third-Party Stores Outside U.S.
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
items.excerpt: Third-party Android app stores can now apply to Google for permission to install apps with one tap, without Android's usual confirmation screens, and to update them in the background.

items.title: Researcher Reveals How Logic Bugs Alone Cracked Microsoft Edge in $175,000 Pwn2Own Win
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
items.excerpt: A chain of logic flaws, with no memory corruption, can turn a malicious web page into code running on a Windows computer outside Microsoft Edge's sandbox, a security researcher has shown.

items.title: Linux Kernel TCP Flaw With 9.8 CVSS Score Affects Ubuntu, Red Hat and Other Distributions
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
items.excerpt: A flaw in the Linux kernel's TCP code, tracked as CVE-2026-98432, affects Ubuntu, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and other Linux distributions. The kernel's own CVE team rates it 9.8 out of 10 on the CVSS scale.

items.title: ThreatsDay: Critical Firewall Flaws, Banking Trojans Rented, Weaponized PDF, Token Theft + 26 More Stories
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
items.excerpt: Some attacks take real skill. Others just need someone to leave a door open. This week has both. Exposed passwords, old bugs still getting exploited, and trusted software doing things it shouldn't. There's a strange mix of clever tricks and careless mistakes.

items.title: GoAhead TLS Flaws Allow Revoked Client Certificates and Enable Session Decryption
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
items.excerpt: The GoAhead embedded web server loaded a certificate revocation list into its default TLS backend but never turned revocation checking on, so a revoked client certificate could still pass login on affected setups.
